messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service inference-gpu-worker. Signal: GPU memory pressure -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY on node gpu-node-7 (GPU 7). Time: 2026-03-13T03:04:49Z

Tessa: ack. I'm the oncall, jumping in.

PagerDuty: Incident PD-11819 acknowledged by Tessa.

Ravi: seeing pattern of small bursts of memory growth after warmup. Allocation requests spike during concurrent cache rebuilds. Stack trace snippet:
```
[2026-03-13T03:04:42Z] ERR cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-13T03:04:43Z] INFO cache: starting parallel rebuild (concurrency=6)
[2026-03-13T03:04:45Z] ERR cache: unable to reserve block for keygroup 0x12
```

Nora: customer impact: approx 1.8% of requests returned 5xx in the last 5m; majority auto-failed over but two enterprise customers hit sustained latency and some retried failed. No data corruption.

Tessa: plan -> 1) reduce cache rebuild concurrency to 2 in-flight, 2) cordon and drain node gpu-node-7, 3) scale up spare lowmem pool to absorb traffic. Doing step 1 now.

infra-bot: Applied config change: kv-cache.rebuild_concurrency=2 for deployment kv-cache-prod. Restarting pods (rolling restart).

Ravi: reducing concurrency seems to slow rebuild but memory delta still climbs slowly. Initiating drain of gpu-node-7.

Tessa: commands if needed:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
``` 

infra-bot: Node cordoned. Pods evicted. Traffic steering policy engaged to divert new sessions away from node.

Ravi: also bumped autoscaler min nodes for lowmem-pool to 4 to take more traffic.

Nora: telemetry shows error rate dropping to 0.6% after diversion. P95 latency on lowmem pool ~ 220ms vs 120ms normal.

Tessa: good. I'm going to restart nvidia runtime on gpu-node-7 and rotate the runtime shim to apply ephemeral memory limits. Doing restart now.

Ravi: restarting container runtime. If not resolved, we'll disable prefix caching for the top 3 high-QPS customers as an emergency switch.

infra-bot: nvidia-container-runtime restart completed on gpu-node-7. Pods rescheduled to other nodes.

Ravi: post-restart memory profiles look stable; no new cudaMalloc errors in the last 90s.

Tessa: holding for 8m to monitor. If stable, we'll uncordon and slowly reprovision node with reduced cache memory ceiling.

Nora: created incident note with timeline and customer impact; will open follow-up ticket to add an alert that correlates CUDA OOMs with customer 5xx spikes.

PagerDuty: No escalation required. Incident PD-11819 remains acknowledged.

Tessa: uncordoning in 2m with reduced cache max_size=8GB on that node (config applied via nodeSelector patch). Will watch.

Ravi: node reintroduced, readiness checks passed. Memory plateau within expected ranges.

Tessa: handing off to Ravi for next hour. I'll file retro and root cause draft. Thanks all.

PagerDuty: Incident PD-11819 closed by Tessa.

Tessa: final notes: suspected cause is overly aggressive parallel cache rebuild + stale eviction heuristics after a config roll two days ago; follow-ups: (a) add headroom pre-check before rebuilds, (b) tune eviction policy, (c) add canary for cache config changes. Thread archived.
